results.hypothesis: To determine whether a hybrid approach combining Sufficient Dimension Reduction (SDR) with supervised feature selection can preserve sufficient classification signal in gene expression data to achieve >90% accuracy using less than 10% of the original features.
results.author: coder-agent
results.baseline: Performance of standard PCA + feature selection and standalone SDR methods on the same dataset
results.success_criteria: If the hybrid approach achieves >90% classification accuracy while using <10% of the original features, the hypothesis is supported. If it fails to meet either condition, the hypothesis is refuted.
results.notes: Best hybrid accuracy was 34.88%, which is below 90%
results.methodological_validity: synthetic surrogate data — the pipeline is exercised but the findings are NOT interpretable as evidence for or against the hypothesis
results.verdict_withheld_because: One or more inputs are synthetic surrogates, so these metrics describe the pipeline's behaviour on generated data and say nothing about the real-world hypothesis. See data_provenance.json.
